name: @pipeworx/mcp-helius

tools.name: helius_parsed_transactions
tools.description: Parsed transaction history for a Solana address — human-readable, enriched tx feed (swaps, NFT sales, transfers) with a plain-English description, type, source protocol, fee, and timestamp for each transaction. Deeper than a raw signature list. Example: helius_parsed_transactions({ address: "86xCnPeV69n6t3DnyGvkKobf9FdN2H9oiVDdaMpo2MMY", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

address.description: Solana wallet or program address (base58), e.g. "86xCnPeV69n6t3DnyGvkKobf9FdN2H9oiVDdaMpo2MMY"

_apiKey.description: Helius API key (free 1M credits/mo at helius.dev)

tools.name: helius_assets_by_owner
tools.description: Tokens & NFTs owned by a Solana wallet — lists every digital asset (fungible tokens, regular + compressed NFTs) held by an address via the Digital Asset Standard (DAS), with name, symbol, balance, and interface type. Example: helius_assets_by_owner({ address: "86xCnPeV69n6t3DnyGvkKobf9FdN2H9oiVDdaMpo2MMY", _apiKey: "your-key" })

address.description: Solana wallet address (base58) whose assets to list

_apiKey.description: Helius API key (free 1M credits/mo at helius.dev)

tools.name: helius_asset
tools.description: Details for a Solana asset/mint — full Digital Asset Standard (DAS) record for a single token or NFT by its mint address: metadata (name/symbol/interface), current ownership, royalty config, and supply. Example: helius_asset({ id: "F9Lw3ki3hJ7PF9HQXsBzoY8GyE6sPoEZZdXJBsTTD2rk", _apiKey: "your-key" })

id.description: Asset ID — typically the mint address of the token/NFT (base58)

_apiKey.description: Helius API key (free 1M credits/mo at helius.dev)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-helius forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the helius pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
